image-alt.title: Images must have alternative text
image-alt.message: The image has no alt attribute.
image-alt.fix: Add an alt that conveys the meaning of the image; use an empty alt="" for decorative images.

image-alt-quality.title: Alternative text must be meaningful
image-alt-quality.message: The alt text “{alt}” does not describe the image (file name or generic word).
image-alt-quality.fix: Describe what is shown and why it matters. Avoid “image”, “photo” and file names.
image-alt-quality.review: Very long alt text ({alt_length} characters): shorten it or move the description into the page text.

image-input-alt.title: Image buttons must have alternative text
image-input-alt.message: input type="image" has no alternative text.
image-input-alt.fix: Add an alt naming the action, e.g. “Search”.

area-alt.title: Image map areas must have alt text
area-alt.message: The <area> link has no text description.
area-alt.fix: Add an alt describing where the link goes.

svg-img-alt.title: SVG with role img must have a name
svg-img-alt.message: SVG with role="img" has no accessible name.

embedded-alt.title: Embedded objects must have a text alternative
embedded-alt.message: The embedded object has no name or fallback text.
embedded-alt.fix: Add aria-label or fallback content inside the element.

video-captions.title: Videos must have captions
video-captions.fix: Add a WebVTT caption track. It helps deaf and hard-of-hearing students and anyone watching without sound.

audio-transcript.title: Audio needs a text transcript
audio-transcript.message: The audio recording needs a transcript — check that one is provided nearby.
audio-transcript.fix: Link to a text transcript next to the player.

embedded-video-review.title: Embedded video: check captions
embedded-video-review.message: Embedded video ({host}): captions cannot be verified automatically.
embedded-video-review.fix: Make sure the video has accurate captions and a transcript, and enable captions by default.

media-autoplay.title: Do not autoplay audio or video
media-autoplay.message: Media starts automatically and can interfere with reading and screen readers.
media-autoplay.fix: Remove autoplay or make the video muted with visible controls.

document-title.title: Pages must have a descriptive title
document-title.message: The <title> is missing or not descriptive.
document-title.fix: Set a <title> that briefly describes the page and course.

page-has-h1.title: Pages should have a level-one heading
page-has-h1.fix: Add a single <h1> with the page name.

heading-order.title: Heading levels should not be skipped
heading-order.message: Heading h{to} follows h{from}: a level is skipped.
heading-order.fix: Do not skip levels: h1 → h2 → h3. Use CSS for appearance.

heading-empty.title: Headings must not be empty
heading-empty.fix: Add text or remove the heading.

landmark-main.title: The page must have exactly one main landmark
landmark-main.message: The <main> landmark is missing or duplicated ({count}).
landmark-main.fix: Wrap the main content in a single <main> element.

bypass-blocks.title: A way to bypass repeated blocks is needed
bypass-blocks.message: No skip link, main landmark or headings for navigation.
bypass-blocks.fix: Add a “Skip to content” link first and use <main> and headings.

list-structure.title: Lists must be marked up correctly
list-structure.message: Invalid list structure: <li> outside a list or a foreign child inside ul/ol.
list-structure.fix: Put <li> only inside <ul>/<ol>, and only <li> inside lists.

table-headers.title: Data tables need headers
table-headers.message: The table has no <th> header cells.
table-headers.fix: Mark column and row headers with <th scope="col|row">.

duplicate-id.title: id values must be unique
duplicate-id.fix: Make ids unique: labels and ARIA rely on them.

meta-refresh.title: Do not refresh the page automatically
meta-refresh.message: Automatic refresh or redirect after {delay} s.
meta-refresh.fix: Remove meta refresh and let users decide when to reload.

blink-marquee.title: Do not use blinking or scrolling text
blink-marquee.message: The obsolete blink/marquee element is used.
blink-marquee.fix: Use static text; make any animation pausable.

viewport-zoom.title: Zooming must not be blocked
viewport-zoom.message: Page zoom is disabled in meta viewport.
viewport-zoom.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and any maximum-scale below 2.

frame-title.title: Frames must have a title
frame-title.message: The iframe has no title attribute.
frame-title.fix: Add a title describing the frame content.

html-lang.title: The page language must be set
html-lang.message: The <html> element has no lang attribute.
html-lang.fix: Add lang, e.g. <html lang="en">. Screen readers use it for pronunciation.

html-lang-valid.title: The page language code must be valid
html-lang-valid.fix: Use BCP 47 codes: en, ru, kk, en-US.

lang-parts-valid.title: Language codes of page parts must be valid
lang-parts-valid.fix: Use BCP 47 codes: en, ru, kk.

lang-content-mismatch.title: The page language must match its text
lang-content-mismatch.message: The declared language is “{declared}” but the text looks like “{detected}”.
lang-content-mismatch.fix: Check the page lang and mark passages in other languages with lang.

form-label.title: Form fields must have labels
form-label.message: The form field has no label.
form-label.fix: Associate a <label for> with the field or add aria-label.

placeholder-label.title: A placeholder is not a label
placeholder-label.message: The only name of the field is its placeholder, which disappears while typing.
placeholder-label.fix: Add a visible <label>; keep the placeholder for an example.

autocomplete.title: Personal data fields should support autofill
autocomplete.message: The field can be autofilled but has no autocomplete (expected “{expected}”).
autocomplete.fix: Add an autocomplete attribute with a suitable token.

radio-group.title: Radio and checkbox groups must be grouped
radio-group.message: The group “{name}” ({count} items) is not wrapped in a fieldset with a legend.
radio-group.fix: Wrap the group in a <fieldset> with a <legend>.

button-name.title: Buttons must have a name
button-name.message: The button has no accessible name.

link-name.title: Links must have a name
link-name.message: The link has no text or accessible name.
link-name.fix: Add link text or aria-label; use alt on images inside links.

link-text-generic.title: Link text must make sense out of context
link-text-generic.message: The link “{text}” says nothing about its destination.
link-text-generic.fix: Describe the target: “Course syllabus (PDF)” instead of “Download”.

document-link-review.title: Linked documents: check accessibility
document-link-review.message: Link to a .{format} file: make sure it is tagged (structure, headings, alt) and the format is stated.
document-link-review.fix: State format and size in the link text; check the document or provide an HTML version.

nested-interactive.title: Interactive elements must not be nested
nested-interactive.message: A link or button contains another control ({inner}).

tabindex-positive.title: Do not use positive tabindex
tabindex-positive.message: tabindex={tabindex} breaks the natural focus order.
tabindex-positive.fix: Use tabindex="0" or -1 and arrange elements in source order.

mouse-only-handler.title: Mouse actions must work from the keyboard
mouse-only-handler.message: Click handler on a non-interactive element without {missing}.
mouse-only-handler.fix: Use <button> or <a>; otherwise add role, tabindex="0" and Enter/Space handling.

focusable-aria-hidden.title: Focusable content must not be aria-hidden
focusable-aria-hidden.fix: Remove aria-hidden or make the content unfocusable (tabindex="-1", disabled).

aria-valid-role.title: ARIA roles must be valid
aria-valid-role.fix: Check the spelling or use a native element.

aria-valid-attr.title: ARIA attributes must exist
aria-valid-attr.fix: Fix the typo in the attribute name.

aria-idref.title: ARIA references must point to existing elements
aria-idref.fix: Make sure an element with that id exists.

aria-required-attr.title: ARIA roles must have required attributes

color-contrast.title: Text must have enough contrast
color-contrast.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background. Need 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
color-contrast.review: Contrast cannot be computed automatically: text over a background image or gradient. Check manually.
